source: Project Operating System Phase 3.5 - Governance Hardening
name: Calculator Contract
objective: Define future calculator registry responsibilities without changing calculator implementation or behavior.

boundary.coreContracts: calculator knowledge capabilities, domains, rules and tables
boundary.posContracts: operational lifecycle, registry, migration, testing and approval process for calculators

notes: Existing calculators are LEGACY_ACCEPTED_PENDING_MIGRATION and do not fail automatically.
New and migrated calculators must resolve the canonical experience contract.
POS does not own calculator legal knowledge; it orchestrates future operational handling.
